title: observability: token + KV cost/latency dashboards, tracing, and alert tuning
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Operator teams and SREs need fine-grained visibility into per-token cost and latency for inference workloads and KV cache effectiveness to make informed routing and capacity decisions. This PR adds token-level cost and latency metrics, KV cache hit/miss counters and latencies, tracing spans for token decode and KV lookup, a new Grafana dashboard for token/KV cost-latency breakdown, and tuned Prometheus alerting rules to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage. Scope: metrics instrumentation, tracing integration, dashboard JSON, alert rules, and docs. Implementation details: - Instrumented per-request token accounting in the serving runtime: token_cost_usd_total, token_latency_ms_histogram, token_count_total (labels: model, route, region, customer_tier). - Added KV cache metrics: kv_cache_hits_total, kv_cache_misses_total, kv_cache_lookup_latency_ms_histogram (labels: shard, model_family). - Tracing: added spans for "token.decode" and "kv.lookup" with attributes for model, route, and cache_result. Spans are emitted to existing OpenTelemetry/Tempo pipeline. - Grafana: dashboard token_kv_cost_latency.json with panels for token cost breakdown by model & route, median/p99 token latency, KV hit rate heatmap, and cost per 1000 tokens. Includes templating for region/model_family. - Alerts: tuned thresholds for token-latency SLO regressive alert to reduce noise during bursty workloads; added a short-window anomaly check (5m) and a sustained-window degradation alert (30m). - Tests: unit tests for metric labeling and end-to-end smoke test that verifies metrics emit when running a short synthetic request. - Docs: observability token metrics guide and dashboard walkthrough added to redwood/docs. Backwards compatibility and rollout: New metrics are additive and exported under existing metrics namespace. Dashboard is optional and added to default observability stack. The change is behind a feature flag (observability.token_kv_breakdown) to allow staged rollout for large customers. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 48 hours, monitor, then enable for beta orgs, then full rollout. Related: ENG-2134 (token accounting), ENG-2190 (kv-metrics), SUP-4821 (customer request for token cost attribution).
